name: Marvin Vettori
summary: A granite-chinned pressure middleweight and former title challenger who lost himself trying to become a slicker, lower-output fighter; four straight losses, all on the cards, and a camp change back to California under Beneil Dariush.

how_they_fight.Striking: At his best as a relentless, high-output pressure fighter; not enough power to win on selective shots.
how_they_fight.Defense & durability: Never been finished in the UFC stretch; the chin is intact.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Can go hard for five rounds.

patterns: Pressure and volume when he's right
keys_to_beat: Make him think; stay long and score

news.text: Left American Top Team to train in California with Beneil Dariush as head coach.

sources.title: Marvin Vettori makes major change following 4 straight UFC losses
